entries.title: Design
entries.description: UX research: user interviews, usability testing, product metrics analysis, and A/B testing. Generating and validating hypotheses based on user data from analytics services. Designing interaction scenarios: CJM, user flows, interface prototyping. Creating and maintaining a component library and design tokens as part of the design system. Writing interface copy in an informative style, aligned with the product's tone of voice.

entries.title: Frontend
entries.description: Development and maintenance of: product interfaces, client-side logic, API interactions, component libraries and design systems, npm packages, and product AI features. Performance optimization. Semantic, responsive, and cross-browser markup: BEM, Mobile-first, animation. Testing of components, APIs, and cross-browser checks.

entries.title: Infrastructure & Tools
entries.description: Working with Jamstack. Setting up and integrating a Headless CMS into the project. Configuring infrastructure for local development and deploying the project on a VPS in Docker. Setting up internal and external routing, including SSL. Configuring CI/CD and building the project. Automating code quality control: git hooks, linting, and formatting. SEO analysis and project optimization. Working with AI tools: writing code, review, refactoring, debugging, and testing.
